title: Split a parallel inspection whose per-command timeout was too short
failure_signature: A parallel status and script-index probe used ten-second per-command limits and timed out before returning its results.
trigger_preconditions: several cold PowerShell and Git probes
candidate_workaround: Repeat the read-only probes with bounded sixty-second command limits and preserve each result separately.
recurrence_guard: Use realistic per-command limits for cold Windows repository probes while keeping user updates below sixty seconds.
rollback: Terminate only the timed-out diagnostic and make no repository mutation.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
